meta.data_residency: Process and persist subscriber-derived signals only in counsel-approved regions and infrastructure; cross-border replication forbidden unless contractually explicit.
meta.counsel_approval: Chairman counsel sign-off required before any production DAPI, SMPP bind, or webhook exposes subscriber-linked traffic to this mirror.

storage_rules.salt: GCSLC_MSISDN_SALT must be set in production; rotate per counsel policy; never commit to VCS.

logging_rules.structured_logs: Must not contain full MSISDN, SMS body beyond hashed/truncated counsel limits, or unrelated PII.
logging_rules.note: Tune retention with operator agreements and NCC-facing schedules.

ingress.primary_http: POST /v1/gantry/event with header X-GCSLC-Ingress-Secret matching GCSLC_INGRESS_SECRET
ingress.smpp: SMPP terminates at licensed aggregator; aggregator normalizes to HTTPS webhook — no MSISDN in mirror-accessible plain logs.

compliance_refs: NCC approvals as applicable to fleet telemetry programs

rules: Reject or hash MSISDN at the edge; mirror sees only consent-gated fleet facts + corridor geometry.
Webhook JSONL is append-only counsel evidence — tamper response per incident playbook.
